name: Harmony 700, the test setup with all seven devices, built from nothing
description: todo-compile-700 2.2 and 2.3, one write of lab/work/h700-from-nothing/setup7-700.bin: the Harmony 650's whole test setup, seven devices and five activities, built on the 700's empty configuration by our own generators and composers with no Logitech file as input and smoothed letters, section 385. The question is whether the 700 takes a seventh device: Logitech's service allows it 8, its manual says 6. Watch TV starts TV kijken, Watch a Movie Film kijken and Listen to Music Muziek. The activity menu has three pages: TV kijken and Film kijken, Muziek and Kodi kijken, Plasma kijken. Predicted: TV kijken sends the LG's, the KPN box's and the Denon's power, then the LG's HDMI 1 and the Denon's CBL/SAT; its volume goes to the Denon and its channels to the KPN box. Muziek from there sends Kodi's and the Sony's power, the Sony's Function three times, the LG's and the Denon's power, and nothing to the KPN box, which is kept on between activities. Film kijken from there sends the Plasma's power on (seven frames), the Denon's and the Sony's power, then the Plasma's HDMI 2 and the Denon's Media Player, and nothing to Kodi, already on. Plasma kijken from there sends Kodi's and the Denon's power and the Plasma's HDMI 1. Radio sends KPN 1 and about 2 s later KPN 2. All Off sends the Plasma's power off and the KPN box's power. The screen goes dark about 20 s after the last key. The three buttons below the screen are the left arrow, the centre button and the right arrow.

steps.instruction: Straight after the write the remote restarts. Take it off the cable while looking at the screen: 'Turning system off' shows for a moment before the Activities screen. Say whether the tops of its letters, the 'T' and the two 'f's, are whole or cut off at the top edge. Then expect the Activities screen, green, 'Activities 1/3' at the top, TV kijken on the upper row and Film kijken on the lower row, 'Devices' at the bottom. Point the remote at the Flirc and mark when it is quiet

Press Watch TV. Expect 'Starting TV kijken', the LG's, the KPN box's and the Denon's power, then the LG's HDMI 1 and the Denon's CBL/SAT, then a blue screen titled TV kijken with Teletext upper left and DVR upper right, 'Devices' at the bottom. Mark when it settles
Press Volume up once, then Channel up once. Expect the Denon's volume up, then the KPN box's channel up. Mark

Press the centre button below the screen ('Devices'). Expect a red 'Devices 1/2': LG TV upper left, KPN upper right, Denon lower left, Plasma lower right, 'Activity' at the bottom. Press the right arrow once. Expect 'Devices 2/2': Kodi upper left, Switch upper right, Sony HT lower left. Press the button beside Sony HT (lower left). Expect the Sony's red pages, 'Sony HT 1/7'. Press the left arrow and right arrow below the screen to see a page or two, then press the centre button ('Back') until the blue TV kijken screen is back. The Flirc hears nothing. Mark

Press Listen to Music. Expect 'Starting Muziek', Kodi's and the Sony's power, the Sony's Function three times, the LG's and the Denon's power, and nothing for the KPN box. Then a blue screen titled Muziek with Sleep upper left. Mark when it settles

Press Watch a Movie. Expect 'Starting Film kijken', the Plasma's power on (seven frames), the Denon's and the Sony's power, then the Plasma's HDMI 2 and the Denon's Media Player, and nothing for Kodi or the KPN box. Then a blue screen titled Film kijken with Aspect upper left, 3D upper right and Sleep lower left. Mark when it settles

Press More Activities. Expect 'Activities 1/3'. Press the right arrow below the screen twice. Expect 'Activities 3/3' with Plasma kijken alone on the upper row. Press the button beside Plasma kijken. Expect 'Starting Plasma kijken', Kodi's and the Denon's power, the Plasma's HDMI 1, and nothing for the KPN box. Then a blue screen with Teletext, DVR, Aspect and Radio in its corners. Mark when it settles
Press the button beside Radio (lower right) once and touch nothing. Expect the KPN box's 1 and about 2 s later its 2. Mark when the 2 has been heard, or when 10 s have passed without it
Press All Off. Expect the Plasma's power off and the KPN box's power, and the Activities screen; 'Turning system off' only flashes, if it shows at all. Mark when it is quiet
Touch nothing and watch the screen: note roughly how many seconds after the last press it goes dark, about 20 expected. Then press any key once to wake it, and mark
